decisions.thought: Choice Scarf Gholdengo leads to outspeed and pressure Garchomp, Gholdengo, and Primarina immediately. Garchomp provides unmatched offensive presence and Ground coverage against Kingambit and Incineroar, while Mimikyu secures the endgame with Disguise and priority.

Speed is the deciding factor with opposing Garchomp and Volcarona threatening to outrun us. Incineroar leads safely with Intimidate and Fake Out to break Mimikyu disguise. Primarina scores likely knockouts on dragons and Volcarona, while Garchomp outspeeds and hits Gholdengo hard.

decisions.thought: Incineroar has a huge type advantage against Gholdengo and easily survives Focus Blast, while threatening an immediate KO. Switching directly into Garchomp is extremely safe against Fire attacks and immediately forces Incineroar out.

Gholdengo is immune to Fake Out and Good as Gold blocks Parting Shot and Taunt. Flare Blitz is super effective for a likely knockout while Incineroar resists its STABs, so this is not a bad matchup to switch out of.

decisions.thought:
Incineroar is slower than Garchomp and in a bad matchup to stay in, risking a knockout from Earthquake.
Primarina is immune to Dragon and threatens back with Fairy coverage, so switching preserves Incineroar.

decisions.thought: Primarina is at 36% HP after taking 64% from Earthquake last turn. Regular Garchomp comfortably outspeeds Primarina, whereas Mega Evolving lowers base Speed unnecessarily, so a regular Earthquake cleanly finishes it off.
Primarina is slower than Garchomp and will be knocked out by Earthquake before Moonblast can fire. This is a bad matchup to stay in. Garchomp is immune to Earthquake for a free switch.

decisions.thought: Mega Evolving drops Garchomp's base Speed from 102 to 92, guaranteeing the opponent moves first. Staying in base form gives a speed tie at worst and Outrage easily finishes off the opposing Garchomp at 51% HP.
We are max Speed 169 so we likely move first in the mirror unless tie, and Dragon Claw should knock out the 66% Garchomp. Mega Evolving would drop our Speed and risk moving second, so stay base.

decisions.thought: Mimikyu has Disguise intact and immunity to Dragon-type attacks, allowing it to safely pick off the weakened Garchomp with Shadow Sneak or Play Rough and sweep the rest of the opponent's damaged team.
Mimikyu has Disguise intact to safely absorb any hit if Garchomp is faster. Play Rough is a guaranteed knockout on Garchomp from 39% HP, whereas Shadow Sneak lacks the damage to finish it.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
**Analyzing Optimal Moves**

I've determined that Life Orb Shadow Sneak can eliminate the opposing Garchomp, which is at 39% health, with certainty. Play Rough is also an option, being super effective and likely to OHKO, but Shadow Sneak ensures the win without needing to risk a miss or speed tie with its priority.

decisions.thought: Garchomp is low HP and weak to Fairy, so this is a bad matchup to stay in against Mimikyu. Switching to Incineroar resists both Ghost and Fairy STAB and drops Attack with Intimidate.

decisions.thought: Mimikyu still has its Disguise intact, meaning Incineroar cannot knock it out this turn. Using Swords Dance offsets Intimidate, bringing Mimikyu to +1 Attack to finish Incineroar and sweep the remaining weakened foes.

Mimikyu is faster and its Disguise is still intact, so Flare Blitz would be blocked for chip while Play Rough hits super effectively.
Preserving Incineroar for Gholdengo matters, so weakening Mimikyu and pivoting out is best.
